competitors.name: Hot Pockets / Nestlé USA
competitors.action: Hot Pockets introduced 'Snack Breaks,' a new bite-sized frozen snack line built around two tear-apart squares per pack in five flavors, extending the brand from meal-style handholds into all-day snacking. The July aisle launch includes 4-ounce singles at a suggested $1.79 and 16-ounce 4-count packs at $5.49, which is a clean signal that legacy frozen brands are chasing smaller-format snack occasions instead of only full-meal occasions.

competitors.name: David
competitors.action: David entered frozen with a high-protein dessert line and sold out its June 1 online launch in 28 minutes, showing how aggressively protein-first challenger brands are moving into indulgent freezer categories. The initial lineup includes four pint flavors, each with 30 grams of protein, 210 to 260 calories, and less than 1 to 2 grams of sugar per pint.

competitors.name: Farm Rich
competitors.action: Farm Rich expanded its frozen snack lineup with Snack-Sized Ranch Mini Mozzarella Sticks and Snack-Sized Loaded Potato Tots, launched at Publix in May with broader retail rollout planned for this summer. The move reinforces that frozen appetizer brands are leaning into smaller, mix-and-match formats designed for flexible snacking and casual at-home occasions.

trends.topic: Frozen innovation is tilting toward snackable formats and protein-forward indulgence
trends.magnitude: Hot Pockets moved into bite-sized snack packs, Farm Rich pushed snack-sized appetizers, and David sold out a high-protein frozen dessert launch in 28 minutes
trends.context: The clearest daily signal is that freezer innovation is clustering around flexible snacking and nutritionally optimized indulgence rather than only traditional center-of-plate meals. For Real Dough, that suggests opportunity in portable portions, occasion-based bundles, and stronger messaging around premium freezer-night versatility.

breaking.headline: Today's strongest signal is that frozen CPG players are pushing harder into snack-sized and protein-forward formats.
breaking.impact: Hot Pockets, Farm Rich, and David are all expanding freezer demand beyond classic meal occasions, either through smaller grab-and-go formats or higher-protein indulgence. Real Dough should keep watching how premium frozen consumers respond to portion flexibility, snackable formats, and stronger functional positioning.
